Fields.Name: Asset ID
Fields.Description: Asset to create (AEG999_999 -> 999999). Must exist in AssetEnvironmentGeometryParam and not be a static asset (behaviour type 1), and needs a Lifetime above 0 here or in the asset's own runtime lifetime.

Fields.Name: Slot Number
Fields.Description: Only one asset per slot at a time: while a slot is in use (including its delay), rows with that slot are not checked and their elapsed timers restart.

Fields.Name: Create Condition Type
Fields.Description: 0: on a weather change matching the Transition Source/Destination Weather. 1: after Elapsed Time Weather has lasted Elapsed Time seconds.

Fields.Name: Transition Source Weather
Fields.Description: Type 0: the weather being left. -2: any weather. -1 makes the row invalid.

Fields.Name: Transition Destination Weather
Fields.Description: Type 0: the new weather. -2: any weather. -1 makes the row invalid. The asset is removed when the weather changes away from it.

Fields.Name: Check Weather Elapsed Time
Fields.Description: Specify the weather to check the elapsed time.

Fields.Name: Elapsed Time
Fields.Description: Type 1: seconds (real time) the weather must last before a roll. The timer restarts after every roll and whenever the weather changes.

Fields.Name: Create Delay Time
Fields.Description: Seconds between a successful roll and the asset appearing; the slot is held meanwhile. 0 or less: created immediately.

Fields.Name: Create Chance
Fields.Description: Specifies the probability of occurrence when conditions for weather transitions or elapsed time are met.

Fields.Name: Lifetime
Fields.Description: Seconds the asset stays. It is also removed early when its weather ends or the hour leaves the create window, and cut short when the map's asset limit ID stops matching.

Fields.Name: Fade Time
Fields.Description: Fade-in and fade-out time of the asset, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Create Window Start Hour
Fields.Description: In-game hour (0.0-24.0) from which the asset can be created and kept. Either value below 0: any time.

Fields.Name: Create Window End Hour
Fields.Description: In-game hour (0.0-24.0) until which the asset can be created and kept (inclusive). Either value below 0: any time.

Fields.Name: Create Point [0]
Fields.Description: Spawn point: the NNN of an MSB region named exactly WeatherCreateAssetPoint_NNN in the player's map. One of the set points (0 or more) is picked at random. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Create Point [1]
Fields.Description: Spawn point: the NNN of an MSB region named exactly WeatherCreateAssetPoint_NNN. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Create Point [2]
Fields.Description: Spawn point: the NNN of an MSB region named exactly WeatherCreateAssetPoint_NNN. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Create Point [3]
Fields.Description: Spawn point: the NNN of an MSB region named exactly WeatherCreateAssetPoint_NNN. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Asset Limit ID [0]
Fields.Description: Created only where the map's weather asset limit ID (MapDefaultInfoParam WeatherCreateAssetLimitId, collision override) equals one of these four. Maps without a limit ID allow any row. -1: matches nothing.

Fields.Name: Asset Limit ID [1]
Fields.Description: Second allowed map asset limit ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Asset Limit ID [2]
Fields.Description: Third allowed map asset limit ID. -1: none.

Fields.Name: Asset Limit ID [3]
Fields.Description: Fourth allowed map asset limit ID. -1: none.
